title: Current Electricity

sections.title: Microscopic Electric Current, Drift Velocity, and Ohm's Law
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Establish the microscopic mechanism of conduction electrons, derive I = n e A v_d, formulate current density J = sigma E, and distinguish thermal electronic motion from collective drift velocity.
unresolved_gaps: No verified canonical question atoms or worked examples for numerical drift velocity calculation in current staging.

sections.title: Macroscopic Resistance, Material Resistivity, and Wire Recasting
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Relate resistance to conductor geometry R = rho l / A and analyze resistance scaling under volume conservation during wire stretching and recasting, explicitly disproving 1/r^2 area-only scaling.

sections.title: Resistor Networks, Symmetry Reductions, and Equivalent Resistance
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Master series and parallel reductions, delta-wye transformations, and nodal symmetry methods for complex resistor lattices.
source_references: University Physics with Modern Physics, 13th Edition.pdf
unresolved_gaps: Subtopic 'combinations-of-resistors' has no approved formula records or question atoms in ChapterSpec.
Lacks bridge circuit questions and symmetry reduction examples in current KB.

sections.title: Kirchhoff's Laws and Multi-Loop DC Circuit Analysis
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Apply Kirchhoff's Current Law (conservation of charge) and Voltage Law (conservation of energy) systematically using branch-current and node-voltage methods.
unresolved_gaps: Subtopic 'kirchhoffs-laws' lacks approved formula records (sum I = 0, sum V = 0) and canonical question atoms in ChapterSpec.

sections.title: Electrical Measuring Instruments: Ideal and Real Ammeters and Voltmeters
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Model circuit instrumentation, establish the ideal ammeter (R_A -> 0) and ideal voltmeter (R_V -> infty) boundary conditions, and eliminate the misconception that branch ammeters read total battery current.
unresolved_gaps: Need a dedicated worked example for galvanometer conversion to ammeter (shunt resistance) and voltmeter (multiplier resistance).

pedagogical_synthesis_notes: Electrodynamics Template: Progression moves logically from microscopic carrier kinetics (v_d, J, sigma) to macroscopic geometrical resistance (R = rho L / A), network topology, and experimental measurement instrumentation.

Misconception-Driven Instruction: Section 2 aggressively targets misc-curr-01 via worked example ex-curr-recast-wire-01 and question current-electricity-question-ce6aab7f, cementing the 1/r^4 scaling law resulting from volume conservation.

Network Branching & Measurement: Section 5 eliminates misc-curr-02 through dual practice atoms current-electricity-question-3a1b8c4d and current-electricity-question-d2492f7f, instilling rigorous nodal current splitting principles before instrument readings.
unresolved_gaps: Gap in Topic 'electric-current-and-drift': Lacks canonical questions for electron drift velocity and mobility calculations.
Gap in Topic 'resistance-and-resistivity': Missing formula records and questions for temperature coefficient of resistance (alpha) and color code/standard combinations.
Gap in Topic 'dc-circuits': Kirchhoff's laws and potentiometer/Wheatstone bridge lack canonical formula records and worked examples in current ChapterSpec.
